paragraphs.text: And it came to pass when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judaea beyond the Jordan;
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε ἐτέλεσεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς τοὺς λόγους τούτους, μετῆρεν ἀπὸ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς τὰ ὅρια τῆς Ἰουδαίας πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου.
paragraphs.translit: Kai egeneto hote etelesen ho Iēsous tous logous toutous, metēren apo tēs Galilaias kai ēlthen eis ta horia tēs Ioudaias peran tou Iordanou.

paragraphs.text: and great multitudes followed him; and he healed them there.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ ὄχλοι πολλοί, καὶ ἐθεράπευσεν αὐτοὺς ἐκεῖ.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēkolouthēsan autō ochloi polloi, kai etherapeusen autous ekei.

paragraphs.text: And there came unto him Pharisees, trying him, and saying, Is it lawful [for a man] to put away his wife for every cause?
paragraphs.original: Καὶ προσῆλθον αὐτῷ Φαρισαῖοι πειράζοντες αὐτὸν καὶ λέγοντες· Εἰ ἔξεστιν ἀνθρώπῳ ἀπολῦσαι τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ κατὰ πᾶσαν αἰτίαν;
paragraphs.translit: Kai prosēlthon autō Pharisaioi peirazontes auton kai legontes· Ei exestin anthrōpō apolysai tēn gynaika autou kata pasan aitian;

paragraphs.text: And he answered and said, Have ye not read, that he who made [them] from the beginning made them male and female,
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν· Οὐκ ἀνέγνωτε ὅτι ὁ κτίσας ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτοὺς
paragraphs.translit: ho de apokritheis eipen· Ouk anegnōte hoti ho ktisas apʼ archēs arsen kai thēly epoiēsen autous

paragraphs.text: and said, For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶπεν· Ἕνεκα τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ κολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν;
paragraphs.translit: kai eipen· Heneka toutou kataleipsei anthrōpos ton patera kai tēn mētera kai kollēthēsetai tē gynaiki autou, kai esontai hoi dyo eis sarka mian;

paragraphs.text: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
paragraphs.original: ὥστε οὐκέτι εἰσὶν δύο ἀλλὰ σὰρξ μία. ὃ οὖν ὁ θεὸς συνέζευξεν ἄνθρωπος μὴ χωριζέτω.
paragraphs.translit: hōste ouketi eisin dyo alla sarx mia. ho oun ho theos synezeuxen anthrōpos mē chōrizetō.

paragraphs.text: They say unto him, Why then did Moses command to give a bill of divorcement, and to put [her] away?
paragraphs.original: λέγουσιν αὐτῷ· Τί οὖν Μωϋσῆς ἐνετείλατο δοῦναι βιβλίον ἀποστασίου καὶ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν;
paragraphs.translit: legousin autō· Ti oun Mōysēs eneteilato dounai biblion apostasiou kai apolysai autēn;

paragraphs.text: He saith unto them, Moses for your hardness of heart suffered you to put away your wives: but from the beginning it hath not been so.
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὅτι Μωϋσῆς πρὸς τὴν σκληροκαρδίαν ὑμῶν ἐπέτρεψεν ὑμῖν ἀπολῦσαι τὰς γυναῖκας ὑμῶν, ἀπʼ ἀρχῆς δὲ οὐ γέγονεν οὕτως.
paragraphs.translit: legei autois hoti Mōysēs pros tēn sklērokardian hymōn epetrepsen hymin apolysai tas gynaikas hymōn, apʼ archēs de ou gegonen houtōs.

paragraphs.text: And I say unto you, Whosoever shall put away his wife, except for fornication, and shall marry another, committeth adultery: and he that marrieth her when she is put away committeth adultery.
paragraphs.original: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ὅτι ὃς ἂν ἀπολύσῃ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ μὴ ἐπὶ πορνείᾳ καὶ γαμήσῃ ἄλλην μοιχᾶται καὶ ὁ ἀπολελυμένην γαμήσας μοιχᾶται.
paragraphs.translit: legō de hymin hoti hos an apolysē tēn gynaika autou mē epi porneia kai gamēsē allēn moichatai kai ho apolelymenēn gamēsas moichatai.

paragraphs.text: The disciples say unto him, If the case of the man is so with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.
paragraphs.original: Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί· Εἰ οὕτως ἐστὶν ἡ αἰτία τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μετὰ τῆς γυναικός, οὐ συμφέρει γαμῆσαι.
paragraphs.translit: Legousin autō hoi mathētai· Ei houtōs estin hē aitia tou anthrōpou meta tēs gynaikos, ou sympherei gamēsai.

paragraphs.text: But he said unto them, Not all men can receive this saying, but they to whom it is given.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Οὐ πάντες χωροῦσι τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἀλλʼ οἷς δέδοται.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen autois· Ou pantes chōrousi ton logon touton allʼ hois dedotai.

paragraphs.text: For there are eunuchs, that were so born from their mother`s womb: and there are eunuchs, that were made eunuchs by men: and there are eunuchs, that made themselves eunuchs for the kingdom of heaven`s sake. He that is able to receive it, let him receive it.
paragraphs.original: εἰσὶν γὰρ εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες ἐκ κοιλίας μητρὸς ἐγεννήθησαν οὕτως, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνουχίσθησαν ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ εἰσὶν εὐνοῦχοι οἵτινες εὐνούχισαν ἑαυτοὺς διὰ τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν. ὁ δυνάμενος χωρεῖν χωρείτω.
paragraphs.translit: eisin gar eunouchoi hoitines ek koilias mētros egennēthēsan houtōs, kai eisin eunouchoi hoitines eunouchisthēsan hypo tōn anthrōpōn, kai eisin eunouchoi hoitines eunouchisan heautous dia tēn basileian tōn ouranōn. ho dynamenos chōrein chōreitō.

paragraphs.text: Then were there brought unto him little children, that he should lay his hands on them, and pray: and the disciples rebuked them.
paragraphs.original: Τότε προσηνέχθησαν αὐτῷ παιδία ἵνα τὰς χεῖρας ἐπιθῇ αὐτοῖς καὶ προσεύξηται· οἱ δὲ μαθηταὶ ἐπετίμησαν αὐτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: Tote prosēnechthēsan autō paidia hina tas cheiras epithē autois kai proseuxētai· hoi de mathētai epetimēsan autois.

paragraphs.text: But Jesus said, Suffer the little children, and forbid them not, to come unto me: for to such belongeth the kingdom of heaven.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Ἄφετε τὰ παιδία καὶ μὴ κωλύετε αὐτὰ ἐλθεῖν πρός με, τῶν γὰρ τοιούτων ἐστὶν ἡ βασιλεία τῶν οὐρανῶν.
paragraphs.translit: ho de Iēsous eipen· Aphete ta paidia kai mē kōlyete auta elthein pros me, tōn gar toioutōn estin hē basileia tōn ouranōn.

paragraphs.text: And he laid his hands on them, and departed thence.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐπιθεὶς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς ἐπορεύθη ἐκεῖθεν.
paragraphs.translit: kai epitheis tas cheiras autois eporeuthē ekeithen.

paragraphs.text: And behold, one came to him and said, Teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?
paragraphs.original: Καὶ ἰδοὺ εἷς προσελθὼν αὐτῷ εἶπεν· Διδάσκαλε, τί ἀγαθὸν ποιήσω ἵνα σχῶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον;
paragraphs.translit: Kai idou heis proselthōn autō eipen· Didaskale, ti agathon poiēsō hina schō zōēn aiōnion;

paragraphs.text: And he said unto him, Why askest thou me concerning that which is good? One there is who is good: but if thou wouldest enter into life, keep the commandments.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Τί με ἐρωτᾷς περὶ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ; εἷς ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαθός· εἰ δὲ θέλεις εἰς τὴν ζωὴν εἰσελθεῖν, τήρησον τὰς ἐντολάς.
paragraphs.translit: ho de eipen autō· Ti me erōtas peri tou agathou; heis estin ho agathos· ei de theleis eis tēn zōēn eiselthein, tērēson tas entolas.

paragraphs.text: He saith unto him, Which? And Jesus said, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness,
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ· Ποίας; ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν· Τὸ Οὐ φονεύσεις, Οὐ μοιχεύσεις, Οὐ κλέψεις, Οὐ ψευδομαρτυρήσεις,
paragraphs.translit: legei autō· Poias; ho de Iēsous eipen· To Ou phoneuseis, Ou moicheuseis, Ou klepseis, Ou pseudomartyrēseis,

paragraphs.text: Honor thy father and mother; and, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
paragraphs.original: Τίμα τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα, καὶ Ἀγαπήσεις τὸν πλησίον σου ὡς σεαυτόν.
paragraphs.translit: Tima ton patera kai tēn mētera, kai Agapēseis ton plēsion sou hōs seauton.

paragraphs.text: The young man saith unto him, All these things have I observed: what lack I yet?
paragraphs.original: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ νεανίσκος· Πάντα ταῦτα ἐφύλαξα· τί ἔτι ὑστερῶ;
paragraphs.translit: legei autō ho neaniskos· Panta tauta ephylaxa· ti eti hysterō;

paragraphs.text: Jesus said unto him, If thou wouldest be perfect, go, sell that which thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me.
paragraphs.original: ἔφη αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς· Εἰ θέλεις τέλειος εἶναι, ὕπαγε πώλησόν σου τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ δὸς πτωχοῖς, καὶ ἕξεις θησαυρὸν ἐν οὐρανοῖς, καὶ δεῦρο ἀκολούθει μοι.
paragraphs.translit: ephē autō ho Iēsous· Ei theleis teleios einai, hypage pōlēson sou ta hyparchonta kai dos ptōchois, kai hexeis thēsauron en ouranois, kai deuro akolouthei moi.

paragraphs.text: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sorrowful; for he was one that had great possessions.
paragraphs.original: ἀκούσας δὲ ὁ νεανίσκος τὸν λόγον ἀπῆλθεν λυπούμενος, ἦν γὰρ ἔχων κτήματα πολλά.
paragraphs.translit: akousas de ho neaniskos ton logon apēlthen lypoumenos, ēn gar echōn ktēmata polla.

paragraphs.text: And Jesus said unto his disciples, Verily I say unto you, It is hard for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of heaven.
paragraphs.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι πλούσιος δυσκόλως εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν·
paragraphs.translit: Ho de Iēsous eipen tois mathētais autou· Amēn legō hymin hoti plousios dyskolōs eiseleusetai eis tēn basileian tōn ouranōn·

paragraphs.text: And again I say unto you, It is easier for a camel to go through a needle`s eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
paragraphs.original: πάλιν δὲ λέγω ὑμῖν, εὐκοπώτερόν ἐστιν κάμηλον διὰ τρυπήματος ῥαφίδος εἰσελθεῖν ἢ πλούσιον εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ θεοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: palin de legō hymin, eukopōteron estin kamēlon dia trypēmatos rhaphidos eiselthein ē plousion eis tēn basileian tou theou.

paragraphs.text: And when the disciples heard it, they were astonished exceedingly, saying, Who then can be saved?
paragraphs.original: ἀκούσαντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ ἐξεπλήσσοντο σφόδρα λέγοντες· Τίς ἄρα δύναται σωθῆναι;
paragraphs.translit: akousantes de hoi mathētai exeplēssonto sphodra legontes· Tis ara dynatai sōthēnai;

paragraphs.text: And Jesus looking upon [them] said to them, With men this is impossible; but with God all things are possible.
paragraphs.original: ἐμβλέψας δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Παρὰ ἀνθρώποις τοῦτο ἀδύνατόν ἐστιν, παρὰ δὲ θεῷ πάντα δυνατά.
paragraphs.translit: emblepsas de ho Iēsous eipen autois· Para anthrōpois touto adynaton estin, para de theō panta dynata.

paragraphs.text: Then answered Peter and said unto him, Lo, we have left all, and followed thee; what then shall we have?
paragraphs.original: Τότε ἀποκριθεὶς ὁ Πέτρος εἶπεν αὐτῷ· Ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς ἀφήκαμεν πάντα καὶ ἠκολουθήσαμέν σοι· τί ἄρα ἔσται ἡμῖν;
paragraphs.translit: Tote apokritheis ho Petros eipen autō· Idou hēmeis aphēkamen panta kai ēkolouthēsamen soi· ti ara estai hēmin;

paragraphs.text: And Jesus said unto them, Verily I say unto you, that ye who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of man shall sit on the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς· Ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ὑμεῖς οἱ ἀκολουθήσαντές μοι ἐν τῇ παλιγγενεσίᾳ, ὅταν καθίσῃ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπὶ θρόνου δόξης αὐτοῦ, καθήσεσθε καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐπὶ δώδεκα θρόνους κρίνοντες τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ.
paragraphs.translit: ho de Iēsous eipen autois· Amēn legō hymin hoti hymeis hoi akolouthēsantes moi en tē palingenesia, hotan kathisē ho hyios tou anthrōpou epi thronou doxēs autou, kathēsesthe kai hymeis epi dōdeka thronous krinontes tas dōdeka phylas tou Israēl.

paragraphs.text: And every one that hath left houses, or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or lands, for my name`s sake, shall receive a hundredfold, and shall inherit eternal life.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πᾶς ὅστις ἀφῆκεν οἰκίας ἢ ἀδελφοὺς ἢ ἀδελφὰς ἢ πατέρα ἢ μητέρα ἢ γυναῖκα ἢ τέκνα ἢ ἀγροὺς ἕνεκεν τοῦ ὀνόματός μου, ἑκατονταπλασίονα λήμψεται καὶ ζωὴν αἰώνιον κληρονομήσει.
paragraphs.translit: kai pas hostis aphēken oikias ē adelphous ē adelphas ē patera ē mētera ē gynaika ē tekna ē agrous heneken tou onomatos mou, hekatontaplasiona lēmpsetai kai zōēn aiōnion klēronomēsei.

paragraphs.text: But many shall be last [that are] first; and first [that are] last.
paragraphs.original: πολλοὶ δὲ ἔσονται πρῶτοι ἔσχατοι καὶ ἔσχατοι πρῶτοι.
paragraphs.translit: polloi de esontai prōtoi eschatoi kai eschatoi prōtoi.
